title: Associate | Full Stack Developer | Bengaluru | Engineering as a Service/ Operate
description:
**Role Purpose**


Customize, extend, and integrate Deloitte products inside diverse client codebases. The role is deliberately polyglot — engineers will move between Java microservices on one engagement and a React front\-end on the next. Strength is rapidly ramp\-up on new stacks, not depth in any single one.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Implement client\-specific customizations on top of the product's extension points and configuration layers.
* Build integrations with client systems — identity providers, data warehouses, third\-party APIs, internal services.
* Write deployment scripts, configuration manifests, and migration utilities for each engagement.
* Diagnose and resolve production issues during go\-live and hyper\-care windows.
* Pair with engagement\-team developers to onboard them on the product and hand over operational knowledge.
* Document every non\-trivial customization pattern so the next POD member can repeat it faster.

**Must\-Have Skills \& Experience**

* 2\+ years building and shipping production software across at least two distinct tech stacks.
* Working fluently in at least two of: Java/Spring, Python (FastAPI/Django), Node.js, .NET, Go.
* Front\-end competence in at least one modern framework (React, Angular, or Vue).
* Strong with relational and at least one NoSQL data store; comfortable writing performant queries.
* REST/GraphQL API design and consumption, including auth, pagination, error semantics, and versioning.
* Git\-based workflows, code review discipline, and an instinct for writing tests.

 **Nice\-to\-Have**

* Experience with containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and at least one major cloud platform.
* Exposure to event\-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ, cloud\-native equivalents).
* Mobile development experience (iOS/Android or React Native).
* Prior client\-facing engineering work in a consulting or systems integration setting.

 **Success in This Role Looks Like**

* Ramps up on a new client tech stack within two weeks of engagement kickoff.
* Customizations land cleanly with minimal post\-go\-live defects.
* Documentation produced is detailed enough so that another engineer can repeat the customization without help.
* Engagement teams request this engineer back by name on future POD pulls.

title: Software Dev Engineer I, L4
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


You use technology to validate and verify software, seeking input from team members on the best software test techniques to utilize. Your scope of work is to extend and effectively apply existing automation frameworks for small to mid\-size components and/or product features. You may create or have responsibility to improve existing test tools. You are able to take a defined design and turn it into code and deliver it on schedule, applying appropriate technologies and current software engineering best practices. You write secure, stable, testable, maintainable code with minimal defects. You are proficient in a broad range of data structures and algorithms, knowing when it is appropriate to use them (and when it is not). You make appropriate implementation trade\-off decisions (e.g., array or hash table?). You do not put the company at risk (e.g. pulling in unlicensed code, working on code in unsafe ways, test payment transactions in prod, etc.). You participate in team design, scoping and prioritization discussions. Your input to test plans and test cases are of high quality and high value. You seek to learn the business context and technologies behind your team’s software. You invent, refine and develop your solutions to ensure they are meeting team needs and project goals. You are a passionate advocate for your customer.  

You assume responsibility for the state of the code you inherit, produce, and test. You get your designs, code, and test plans reviewed. You test code thoroughly. You classify, store, and handle data in accordance with Amazon policies. You track risks and mitigate and/or escalate them in a timely manner. You take the time to understand the maintenance characteristics, runtime properties, and dependencies of your team’s software, including hardware platform, operating system and build dependencies. You prevent bugs from causing customer pain. You clearly document your software to ensure that future generations of developers understand the intention behind the test solutions you build. You troubleshoot, research the root cause of problems, and thoroughly resolve defects. You take ownership of problems (even when outside your own domain), propose solutions, and either take ownership for their resolution or ensure a clear hand\-off to the right owner. You participate in the interview process and help your team train and mentor SDE\-T interns.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Engineering
* Experience of 1 to 3 years as an SDE

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Exposure to AWS, Full stack development experience

##### **Project description**

We are seeking an M\-shaped Full\-Stack Technical Lead with expert\-level Java engineering skills and accountability for delivery across the platform. This role is not a traditional full\-stack position—the successful candidate will have deep, end\-to\-end expertise in Java as their primary discipline, while independently managing small\- to medium\-complexity tasks in three secondary areas: React front\-end development, DevSecOps, and Test Automation. AI and Agentic AI tools will be leveraged to enhance capabilities across these secondary domains without requiring deep specialization in each. The role includes platform\-wide technical leadership responsibilities, such as setting standards, reviewing designs, coaching engineers, and embedding quality early through shift\-left practices.


##### **Responsibilities**


Design, develop, and maintain Spring Boot microservices integrating with relational and NoSQL databases, message brokers (Kafka), and internal/external APIs, ensuring scalable and reliable services across on\-premise and cloud environments.


Manage REST API design end\-to\-end, including contract definition, versioning, error handling, performance optimization, and reliability, to meet non\-functional requirements and consumer expectations.


Serve as the technical leader for Java engineering platform\-wide, establishing coding standards, architectural patterns, reviewing designs and pull requests, and providing technical guidance to delivery teams.


Lead performance tuning and optimization of Java services by profiling, identifying bottlenecks related to memory, threading, I/O, and database, and implementing solutions collaboratively with engineering teams.


Implement Test\-Driven Development (TDD) as a foundational practice in Java delivery, ensuring testability is embedded from the outset.


Develop and maintain React components, screens, and features for small


to medium\-complexity front\-end tasks, integrating with back\-end APIs via RESTful services.


Utilize hooks, state management, and component lifecycle methods to deliver functional and responsive user interfaces aligned with design requirements.


Employ AI and Agentic AI tools to expedite front\-end development, including scaffolding components and troubleshooting UI issues, without requiring extensive front\-end specialization.


##### **Skills**


Must have


The role demands advanced proficiency in modern Java programming, emphasizing core concepts such as concurrency, streams, and modular design, with Java 17\+ being preferable. Candidates must exhibit substantial experience in architecting and developing Spring Boot microservices within large\-scale enterprise settings. Expertise in database interactions is essential, including strong skills in SQL, JPA/Hibernate, query optimization, and data modeling. Familiarity with event\-driven system design and message brokers, particularly Apache Kafka, is required. Deploying and managing Java services via containerization (Docker) and orchestration platforms (Kubernetes) is a key responsibility. Additionally, candidates should demonstrate the ability to design robust REST APIs, incorporating principles like contract\-first design, versioning, pagination, error management, and optimization of API performance. Experience in performance tuning involving profiling, heap and thread analysis, garbage collection adjustments, and latency minimization is also necessary. A rigorous approach to test\-driven development and unit/integration testing, using frameworks such as JUnit and Mockito, is expected. Candidates must also have experience delivering solutions in both on\-premise and cloud environments.


Soft skills and front\-end competencies include the ability to construct React components utilizing functional programming patterns, hooks, and state management techniques. A solid command of JavaScript (ES6\+), HTML5, and CSS3 is required to effectively integrate front\-end modules with back\-end RESTful services. Proficiency in managing asynchronous data flows between client and server components is essential to ensure seamless user experiences.


Hard skills:


At least 10 years of experience in IT.


Expertise in Java 17\+ with modern features including concurrency, streams, and modular design


Extensive experience building Spring Boot microservices


Proficient in SQL, JPA/Hibernate, query optimization, and data modeling


Skilled in event\-driven architectures with Apache Kafka


Hands\-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes for Java service deployment


REST API design focusing on contract\-first, versioning, pagination, error handling, and performance


Performance tuning including profiling, heap/thread analysis, garbage collection tuning, latency reduction


Strong TDD and unit/integration testing using JUnit, Mockito, or equivalents


Experience with on\-premise and cloud deployments


Soft skills:


Competent in creating React components using functional components, hooks, and state management


Solid knowledge of JavaScript (ES6\+), HTML5, and CSS3


Ability to integrate front\-end with back\-end REST APIs and manage asynchronous data flows


Nice to have


n/a

title: Senior Technical Consultant – Full Stack (.NET, React), AEC / D&M
description:
**Job Requisition ID \#**


26WD100791**Position Overview**


Autodesk Enterprise Customer Success organization is seeking a talented Senior Technical Consultant to design and implement customized solutions for our Enterprise customers across the Architecture, Engineering \& Construction (AEC) and Design \& Manufacturing (D\&M) industries. In this role, you will work directly with customers to understand their business and technical requirements and collaborate with Autodesk’s global consulting teams to develop tailored solutions, including product customizations, full\-stack applications, enterprise application integrations, and cloud\-based solutions using Autodesk Cloud and on\-premises products. This is an individual contributor role with a substantial level of technical ownership, customer engagement, influence, and responsibility, requiring the ability to translate complex customer needs into scalable and effective technical solutions.

**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with customers to assess the scope of their Autodesk product customization and configuration requirements.
* Analyze customer business requirements and design, develop, customize, configure, and integrate scalable full\-stack solutions across Autodesk products in the Architecture, Engineering \& Construction (AEC) and Design \& Manufacturing (D\&M) portfolios, leveraging Autodesk APIs, SDKs, extensibility frameworks, and cloud platforms.
* Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Autodesk product APIs, Autodesk Platform Services (APS), SDKs, extensibility frameworks, and related technologies.
* Apply AEC and/or D\&M domain knowledge to understand customer workflows, identify opportunities for automation and optimization, and translate business needs into effective technical solutions.
* Design and develop AI/MCP\-enabled plugins and solutions, leveraging modern AI technologies and related frameworks to connect AI capabilities with enterprise applications, data, and Autodesk workflows.
* Develop written specifications to capture business requirements for proposed solutions and configurations.
* Work independently and with internal team members to estimate effort levels.
* Design system architectures, document implementation plans, and create detailed system designs.
* Drive technical design reviews, establish engineering best practices, mentor engineers, and contribute to reusable frameworks and accelerators across consulting engagements.
* Leverage AI\-assisted development tools and modern engineering practices to accelerate solution development, improve code quality, and enhance customer delivery.
* Demonstrate strong customer\-facing communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Build trust with clients at all levels and establish strong problem\-solving relationships with both clients and colleagues.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* A 4\-year bachelor’s degree in Civil/Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field from an accredited institution.
* 5\+ years of experience in software development, with strong expertise in full\-stack web and desktop application development using C\#/.NET technologies.
* Strong understanding of the Architecture, Engineering \& Construction (AEC) and/or Design \& Manufacturing (D\&M) domain, including relevant industry workflows and processes.
* Hands\-on experience customizing, configuring, and integrating Autodesk products or equivalent industry products across the AEC and D\&M portfolios using APIs, SDKs, and extensibility frameworks.
* Experience with Autodesk Platform Services (APS) and cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure and/or AWS.
* Strong experience developing modern web applications using JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern frontend frameworks such as ReactJS.
* Strong experience designing, developing, and consuming REST APIs/Web APIs using ASP.NET/.NET Core, including integrating Autodesk APIs, SDKs, and cloud services with enterprise applications.
* Experience in database schema design, SQL queries, Entity Framework, and working with SQL and NoSQL databases, including SQL Server and graph databases.
* Experience using Git, Jira, and modern source control and collaborative development practices.
* Hands\-on experience with Generative AI/LLM\-based application development and Model Context Protocol (MCP), including integrating AI capabilities with applications, APIs, enterprise data, or tools. Familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude Code is desirable.
* Experience developing and deploying cloud\-native applications using Microsoft Azure and/or AWS, including cloud services, DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization technologies such as Docker.
* Experience in product development is a plus.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong self\-motivation and ability to engage effectively with both external and internal stakeholders.
* Excellent vision and creativity, with the ability to integrate multiple products into cohesive solutions for customers.
* Proven ability to design, develop, and test business solutions through effective workflows.
* Skilled in documenting and understanding current\-state processes.
* Open to new ideas, methods, and learning, with the ability to quickly apply them.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to communicate technical details at both granular and high levels, including planning and status reporting to executives and stakeholders.
* Ability to lead, follow, and support others as required.
* Capable of leading and supporting account and project planning discussions.
* Skilled in resolving customer issues with an innovative, “can\-do” approach.
* Passion for continuous learning and adopting emerging technologies, including **AI\-assisted development, cloud\-native architectures, and Autodesk platform innovations**.

title: Software Development Engineer II (Full-Stack - Node/React)
description:
**About Saltmine**



At Saltmine, we are rebuilding the $300B enterprise workplace design and asset management industry from the ground up. Founded in 2017 and backed by $20M in Series A funding, Saltmine is an enterprise B2B SaaS platform that helps corporate real estate (CRE) teams and enterprise companies plan, design, and optimize their physical workspaces.



By integrating spatial data, employee utilization metrics (such as badge swipes, sensors, and calendars), real\-time collaborative 2D/3D visualization, and automated space planning tools, we act as the single source of truth for the modern workplace. Trusted by global brands like Nike, Snowflake, PG\&E, and Workday, we are transforming a legacy, manual process into an intelligent, data\-driven experience.



As we scale our platform and expand our visual, spatial, and data integrations, we are looking for a highly capable **Software Development Engineer II (SDE 2\)** to join our core product engineering team.


**Role Overview**



As an SDE II at Saltmine, you will play a pivotal role in designing, building, and maintaining robust, high\-performance web applications that power our real\-time spatial planning, visualization, and collaboration modules. You will work across the stack, writing clean, modular backend services in **Node.js (Express \& Nest.js)** and building rich, responsive user interfaces in **React.js**.



This is an opportunity to solve unique engineering challenges around big spatial datasets, interactive floor plan canvas elements, system performance, and collaborative workflow architectures.


* **Experience Level:** 4–6 Years
* **Employment Type:** Full\-time
* **Location:** Remote / Hybrid (as per location)
* **Target Industry Background:** Strong preference for candidates from **Product\-based companies**, specifically in the **B2B SaaS** ecosystem.


**Key Responsibilities**


* **Feature Delivery:** Design, implement, test, and deploy end\-to\-end features using NestJS/Express on the backend and React on the frontend.
* **Architecture \& Scalability:** Write clean, self\-documenting, and testable code. Help design scalable database schemas and API contracts (RESTful/GraphQL).
* **System Optimization:** Identify performance bottlenecks in web clients and backend servers; refactor code and optimize complex queries to ensure snappy, low\-latency performance.
* **Collaborative Development:** Partner closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, and QA engineers to turn complex enterprise requirements into seamless user workflows.
* **Code Quality \& Mentorship:** Participate actively in code reviews, enforce coding guidelines, write comprehensive unit/integration tests, and mentor junior developers.


**Role Requirements**


**Must\-Have Skill Sets**


**Technical Background**


* **Core Languages:** Strong proficiency in **TypeScript** and modern **JavaScript (ES6\+)**.
* **Backend Development:** Minimum 3\+ years of professional hands\-on backend development with **Node.js**, with proven experience in building production APIs using **Express.js** and **Nest.js** frameworks.
* **Frontend Development:** Minimum 2\+ years of professional experience building complex, interactive single\-page applications (SPAs) with **React.js** and state management systems (such as Redux, Recoil, or React Context).
* **Database Management:** Deep understanding of relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) or NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB), including index optimization, complex queries, and data modeling.
* **System Design:** Clear understanding of RESTful API principles, microservices or modular monolith architectures, and MVC patterns.


**Professional Experience \& Profile**


* **Years of Experience:** 4 to 6 years of solid software engineering experience in web\-scale applications.
* **Product Company Pedigree:**  

**Direct, recent experience working in product\-focused companies.** You understand how to build for long\-term maintainability, manage tech debt, and adapt to shifting product\-market requirements.
* **B2B SaaS Mindset:** Experience building enterprise\-grade applications. You understand multitenancy, role\-based access control (RBAC), data isolation, and security best practices.
* **Agile Work Ethic:** Experience working in fast\-paced Agile/Scrum product cycles.


**Good\-to\-Have Skill Sets**


* **Performance Optimization:** Experience optimizing high\-frequency operations, data serialization/deserialization, and rendering optimization (especially around interactive DOMs, SVG, HTML5 Canvas, or WebGL/Three.js).
* **Real\-time Engineering:** Experience with real\-time multiplayer systems using WebSockets (Socket.io) or WebRTC.
* **DevOps \& Cloud Ecosystem:** Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or AWS, Docker containerization, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
* **Modern CSS Frameworks:** Experience with Tailwind CSS, styled\-components, or similar modern CSS methodologies for clean, responsive UI layouts.
* **Testing Libraries:** Solid experience with automated testing tools (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, Mocha/Chai).


**Why Join Saltmine?**


* **Work on a Unique Product:** We aren't just building CRUD dashboards. You will work on a platform that merges complex spatial data, real\-time collaboration tools, and enterprise workflow engines.
* **High Growth \& Impact:** As an SDE 2 in a tight\-knit, collaborative product team, your decisions will directly impact our system architecture, product direction, and customer success.
* **Culture of Autonomy:** We practice radical trust, value open communication, and encourage engineering initiatives and out\-of\-the\-box ideas.
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** Competitive salary and equity packages, flexible work timings, a generous vacation policy, and a focus on work\-life balance and psychological safety.
